Lib Dem leader Ed Davey urged to be more serious

Liberal Democrat leader Ed Davey has been urged to "ditch the stunts and get serious" by some within the party. Despite this, Davey maintains the Lib Dems are "not struggling for relevance" and that MPs are "frustrated at the system." He also stated the party is a "strong force" and will not "give up fight against 'nasty populism'" as their conference aims to firm up their election platform.
